description: M16-specific subset of IOB_PAD_NV (241-cell directive). Cells that Quartus flips ONLY when M16 input is actually used. Suppressing these for E16+G15-only designs avoids floating-input invalid config (probe2 reset trigger 2026-05-04).
method: IOB_PAD_NV cell list ∩ {cell flips in cross_lab_orig (uses M16) but not in probe2 (no M16)}, both at X=32+X=33
note_e16_g15_common: Cells flipped by both probe2 (E16+G15) and cross_lab orig (E16+M16+G15). These should always be emitted.
note_neither: IOB_PAD_NV cells that NEITHER probe2 nor cross_lab orig flipped (vs nv). Either over-emit by codec OR cells specific to designs we haven't covered.
